test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

This is the __cheap __saree in my collection.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. cheapest .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is comparing the saree in the collection to others, implying a superlative degree of comparison.
 
• To correctly express the superlative degree, we use the word **"cheapest"** rather than "cheap," "more cheap," or "most cheapest."
 
• The structure of a superlative degree sentence is **"This is the [adjective + -est] + noun."**

Correct sentence: *This is the **cheapest** saree in my collection*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Degrees of Comparison:**

 
 
• **Positive Degree:** Describes the quality of a noun without comparison. Example: This saree is cheap.
 
• **Comparative Degree:** Compares two nouns. Example: This saree is cheaper than that one.
 
• **Superlative Degree:** Compares one noun to all others in a group. Example: This is the cheapest saree in my collection.
 
 
 
• **Common Errors:**
 
 
• **Using "more" or "most" with adjectives already in superlative form:** Incorrect: "most cheapest."
 
• **Omitting the article "the" before the superlative:** Incorrect: "This is cheapest saree."
